family_semantics.layer_output: decoder output after residual add; not a single writer
family_semantics.attention_writer: self_attn.o_proj.linear output before gated output residual path
family_semantics.moe_down: router-weighted fused experts module output; down_proj parameter has no module hook; ROUTED-EXPERTS-ONLY (no shared expert)
family_semantics.mlp_output: SparseMoeBlock output == moe_down reshaped (routed-only MoE; no shared-expert addition)

metadata.gate_semantics: q_message_gate forget/message projection outputs before tanh; measure only; not message/mlp gate or block-attention controller
metadata.visit_semantics: physical layer x zero-based pass; looped L6-17 passes 0,1,2; other layers pass 0; no flattening
metadata.dtype_storage: float32 raw after stock BF16 inference
metadata_corrections: hard32_corpus_sha256 literal corrected to measured canonical value (script literal was confabulated from truncated prefix; corpus bytes verified identical to canonical pinned in memory/state.yaml)
moe_down/mlp_output semantics corrected: routed-experts-only, no shared expert (source-verified SparseMoeBlock; battery allclose assert passed)

split_half: even pairs vs odd pairs; cosine of paired difference vectors
normalization: paired per-site L2 centroid differences; per-site harmful/safe centring
